scope: Read-only audit of the guard-log digest in the already committed screenshot-guest-001 receipt. Original receipt, raw log, and result were not edited.

digest_finding.explanation: The receipt contains the exact SHA-256 of the Debug 006 guard log, not the screenshot-guest-001 guard log. This proves a wrong digest value was reused/substituted while the receipt was authored; the available files do not establish the human/tooling mechanism that caused the substitution.

boundary: This audit reports the receipt defect without correcting or superseding the original immutable receipt. The runner/result/build claims are not changed by this log-hash mismatch; the guard log content and timestamps agree with the recorded execution metadata.
